correctness.rationale: Orthogonality of distinct images of basis elements and the invertibility of the target structure matrix force disjoint nonempty column supports and hence a monomial isomorphism. On monomial matrices entry-squaring is multiplicative, giving the stated change-of-basis action and stabilizer. A permutation moving m letters fixes (n-m)^2 ordered pairs; each other weighted orbit has at most one degree of freedom, so its total codimension is at least mn/2. Multiplying by the number of scalings and summing from m=2 gives the first geometric bound. A small support of nonunit diagonal entries kills at least m(n-m) coordinates; a large support kills at least the sum of the squares of its nonunit multiplicities, which is greater than n^2/[4(q-2)]. For q=2 the diagonal subgroup is trivial; for q>=3, q^(-1/2)<=(q-1)/q bounds the small-support exponential at the claimed rate. The unconditioned sum of fixed-point fractions bounds the conditioned mean after division by the positive limiting GL density. Burnside gives the exact mean correction. Each orbit with stabilizer size s>=2 contributes |G|(1-1/s)>=|G|/2 to the stabilizer-excess sum, giving the class-uniform bound. This checks all the quantifiers including fixed q and rational automorphisms; the attached script is a finite enumeration, inspected but not executed.

originality.rationale: The distinct published Resultary corank census 340420fa11f4 already proves precisely the all-matrix nonidentity fixed-point sum at the proposed rate and the orbit-count asymptotic uniformly in matrix corank. On the invertible stratum the proof in this review identifies the stabilizer with the full algebra automorphism group, so conditioning that estimate proves the submitted mean excess with the same rate. The remaining claims are exact Burnside, Markov and orbit-stabilizer consequences. This is verified coverage by a stronger result, not an inference of historical priority from catalogue dates.

value.rationale: Generic rigidity and the weighted orbit error are worthwhile mathematical questions, but here the separately proved contribution is a restriction of the stronger uniform corank census and its identical-rate ambient mean bound. The proof does not yield a sharper rate, a new exceptional symmetry law, or a useful new regime, and the class-uniform rarity bound is a direct orbit-stabilizer consequence. There is no supported distinct mathematical increment to preserve as a repair.
